management_remarks: In Q2 FY26, TCS delivered strong constant-currency revenue growth and expanded EBIT margin to 24.8% through disciplined execution and higher fixed-price project productivity. Quarterly TCV stood at USD 9.8 billion, led by multi-year vendor consolidation and AI-infused application managed services contracts in North America and Europe. Free cash flow conversion remained pristine at 98% of PAT with Return on Equity exceeding 51%.
analyst_qa: On third-party software and BSNL hardware pass-through revenue tapering off, reported top-line comparisons face optical headwinds that make sequential acceleration challenging. Global banking clients remain cautious on multi-year regulatory tech budgets amidst uncertain monetary policy paths. Campus hiring additions remain calibrated and subject to quarterly utilization thresholds.
